description: This file contains unit tests for channel target utility functions such as ensureTargetId, requireTargetKind, and buildMessagingTarget. It tests validation logic for target identifiers and kinds within the context of Slack platform integrations.

methods.name: ensureTargetId
methods.description: Validates that the candidate target ID matches the provided pattern. Throws an error with errorMessage if it doesn't match.

methods.name: requireTargetKind
methods.description: Checks that the target object has the specified kind for the given platform. Throws error if missing or mismatched.

methods.name: buildMessagingTarget
methods.description: Constructs a messaging target object with specified platform, ID, and kind.
